Ava: Heads-up 4: ingestion failed for NimbusEdge hardware bundle. Portal flagged PO because taxJurisdiction != seller_tax_id and billing alias missing. Blocked.
Rohan: Can you paste the portal error? need exact validation rule.
Ava: UI says: "PO NE-PO-4201 rejected: tax_jurisdiction_mismatch; missing vendor_alias"
Claire: Is this the vendor_alias we added during onboarding (nimbus-reseller)? They sometimes forget to populate it.
Ben (finance): Finance note: Changing billing entity on our invoice will break monthly tax reporting unless we have a signed attestation. We can do a temporary alias mapping but need ticket and signed doc.
Ava: Quick options: 1) ask Nimbus to reissue PO with vendor_alias=nimbus-reseller and correct taxJurisdiction, or 2) supply a one-page attestation + AR tag to let ingestion proceed. Which is faster?
Rohan: Partner availability? I can ping them. If they can't reissue in <6h we'll do attestation.
ProcureBot: Automated: New ticket PROC-9310 created for NE-PO-4201. Status: awaiting_partner_response. Link: https://redwood.ai/ops/tickets/PROC-9310
Claire: Legal can draft a short attestation: "Redwood confirms Nimbus Reseller (vendor_alias: nimbus-reseller) is the certified seller for PO NE-PO-4201. For invoicing only, Redwood will accept invoices referencing Redwood Inference Inc and will remit payment to Nimbus Reseller. This does not alter underlying agreements." Short + non-modifying.
Ben (finance): That wording is acceptable. AR needs tag schema: vendor_alias:nimbus-reseller, temp_tax_jurisdiction:US-CA, po:NE-PO-4201. Processing ETA once signed: ~5 business hours.
Rohan: Nimbus PM says they can reissue but only after their finance cutoff tonight (10+ hours). They prefer we accept attestation.
Ava: Ok sending Claires attestation draft to Legal for signature, uploading to PROC-9310, and flagging ingestion as manual-review to avoid auto-retry. I'll post signed doc here when available.
ProcureBot: Ticket PROC-9310 status updated -> awaiting_document_upload.
Ava: Thanks all. Keeping thread open for sign-off.
